children: FreightCar America shares declined as the company said it believes that the customer for a tank car retrofit order "is unlikely to be able to meet its obligations" under its contract.
Shares fell 21% to $4.64 after hours. As of the market close, the stock was down 47% this year.

FreightCar America said third-quarter revenue was about $75 million to $77 million, compared to $160.5 million a year earlier. Full-year revenue guidance was reduced to about $370 million to $410 million from $410 million to $460 million.
The company removed 1,285 railcars related to the customer's retrofit order from its backlog, resulting in a preliminary Sept. 30 backlog of 2,660 units.
In August, FreightCar America lowered full-year guidance, reflecting a shift in new railcar delivery timing.
